    You said: how many minutes of exercise per week do adults needhow many minutes of exercise per week do adults need
    AI Overview

    AI Mode reply for how many minutes of exercise per week do adults need

    Adults need at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity or 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic activity each week, along with muscle-strengthening activities on 2 or more days a week.⁠Centers for Disease Control and Prevention | CDC (.gov) +1 
    Aerobic Exercise Guidelines
    • Moderate-intensity (150 minutes/week): Activities like brisk walking, light cycling, or water aerobics (such as 30 minutes a day, 5 days a week).
    • Vigorous-intensity (75 minutes/week): Activities that make you breathe hard and fast, like running, swimming laps, or uphill hiking.
    • Combinations: You can mix moderate and vigorous intensity across the week.
    • More benefits: Increasing moderate activity to 300 minutes per week provides even greater health benefits.⁠nhs.uk +4 
    Strength Training Guidelines
    • Muscle-strengthening: Work all major muscle groups (legs, hips, back, abdomen, chest, shoulders, and arms) using weights, bands, or body weight at least 2 days a week. 
    You can break these minutes up into smaller chunks throughout the week—even short 5- or 10-minute bouts add up. Detailed breakdowns and tips are available through the
    CDC Adult Activity Overview
    or the
    Mayo Clinic Exercise Guide
    .⁠www.heart.org +2 
    If you'd like, let me know:
    • What kind of activities or workouts you enjoy
    • Whether you prefer at-home or gym routines
    I can help you build a simple weekly schedule.
